rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for avoiding or bypassing something, rather than making a full circuit.

example.english: Let’s circumnavigate the road closure ahead by taking a detour.
example.traditional: 前面封咗路，我哋繞過嗰段先啦。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 fung1 zo2 lou6 ngo5 dei6 jiu5 gwo3 go2 dyun6 sin1 laa1

rows.note: For travel-around meanings, this is the all-purpose spoken construction for completing a circuit around a place or object.

example.english: We’ll circumnavigate the island by boat before heading back.
example.traditional: 我哋坐船繞住個島行一圈先返去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 co5 syun4 jiu2 zyu6 go3 dou2 haang4 jat1 hyun1 sin1 faan1 heoi3

rows.jyutping: zaa1 syun4 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3
rows.note: Use this specifically when someone sails around the world rather than merely travelling around it by unspecified means.

example.english: They plan to circumnavigate the world by boat after retiring and take photos along the way.
example.traditional: 佢哋退休後打算揸船環遊世界，仲話要沿途影相。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 teoi3 jau1 hau6 daa2 syun3 zaa1 syun4 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3 zung6 waa6 jiu3 jyun4 tou4 jing2 soeng2
